ABOUT BAANWARD

Local care.
With your property at the centre.

Baanward is a practical property service for people who have found a home in Thailand—or already own one.

A PRACTICAL ROLE

The space between
“I need help” and
“Here’s the next step.”

Choosing a home is only one part of the story. There are visits to arrange, questions to clarify, work to follow up and a property to look after.

Baanward brings those practical tasks into an agreed plan. We support buyers and owners, including clients who are already working with another agent, developer, contractor or building manager.

Our role is to help you see what is happening and coordinate the next steps. We do not offer listings, property sourcing or legal advice.

THE WAY WE APPROACH YOUR PROPERTY

Clear information.
Clear responsibilities.

Start with your concern

Choose the work that helps with your situation, whether it is a single task or scheduled care.

Keep the source visible

Separate our observations from information supplied by others and professional assessments.

Agree before acting

Define authority, access, costs and follow-up before work begins.

WHERE WE CAN HELP

Thailand, with a
local starting point.

Our initial focus is Pattaya, Chonburi and Rayong. We confirm service eligibility, access and availability for each property inquiry.

For other locations, tell us where the property is and what you need. Support is on request, rather than a promise of nationwide coverage.

THE RIGHT HELP, CLEAR RESPONSIBILITIES

Practical care.
Specialist expertise when needed.

Baanward handles practical property coordination. Walailak Law Firm separately handles legal advice, legal due diligence, contracts and legal representation, subject to its own conflict checks and engagement.

Technical inspections and certification need an appropriately scoped specialist. We help coordinate that input and keep responsibilities clear.

We ask your permission before a legal referral. The firm completes its acceptance process before receiving a substantive legal file. Specialist fees are separately scoped unless expressly included.

LET’S START WITH YOUR PROPERTY

A little local support.
A clearer next step.
